faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Here are the most common questions about the free AI watermark remover.

items.question: What is the free AI watermark remover and how does it help me?
items.answer: The free AI watermark remover is a focused image cleanup tool that erases visible watermarks, logos, and text overlays from images you have the right to edit.

items.question: What file types does the free AI watermark remover support?
items.answer: You can upload JPG, PNG, and WEBP images up to 10 MB. Results keep the same format and resolution as the source.

items.question: Can I remove watermarks from AI-generated images?
items.answer: Yes. You can process screenshots and single frames from AI-generated images. For full videos, export the frames you need first.

items.question: Does the free AI watermark remover support batch uploads?
items.answer: The MVP processes one image at a time so each result can be reviewed before download. Multi-image workflows are on the roadmap.

items.question: Is the free AI watermark remover usable on mobile devices?
items.answer: The site works in any modern mobile browser, so you can upload and download from Android or iOS without installing an app.

items.question: Is the free AI watermark remover really free?
items.answer: Yes. Processing and download are completely free during the MVP, with no signup required.

items.question: How long are uploaded images kept?
items.answer: Uploaded images and results are scheduled for automatic deletion after 24 hours, and access links expire automatically.

items.question: How are my images protected?
items.answer: Uploads are stored privately in a private bucket and never receive a permanent public URL.
